concerns.text: FR-006 requires generating a control dataset via random thinning and computing its Lilliefors test statistic. The plan mentions a 'control dataset' in the Summary and Technical Context, but lacks an explicit task or module to generate this control dataset and compute its specific test statistic. The plan only mentions 'validate the heuristic' generally, without a concrete step to produce the control metric required by FR-006 and SC-006.

SC-003 requires measuring the KS statistic trend against asymptotic convergence (specifically comparing N=10^7 to N=5x10^6). The plan's 'Performance Goals' and 'Scale/Scope' mention processing up to 10^7, but the 'Technical Context' and 'Project Structure' do not explicitly define a task to run the analysis across the multiple distinct cutoff values (10^6, 5x10^6, 10^7) required to generate the convergence plot and measure the trend defined in SC-003.

SC-004 requires a quantitative measurement of the QQ-plot alignment (R^2 > 0.99). The plan's 'Statistical Methods' section lists 'QQ-Plot' as a visual tool, but does not include a task or method to calculate the R^2 value of the linear fit to the QQ-plot points, which is necessary to satisfy the measurable outcome in SC-004.

SC-005 requires measuring peak memory usage via /proc/self/status. The plan's 'Performance Goals' state a target of <2GB, but the 'Technical Context' and 'Project Structure' do not include a specific task or module to instrument and log the memory usage (e.g., reading /proc/self/status) to verify this success criterion.
